Indonesian Passenger Ship Lost at Sea, Search Underway

An Indonesian passenger ship carrying 240 people lost contact in the Java Sea. Search and rescue efforts are underway, with aerial footage showing the vessel capsized. As of the latest reports, at least 129 people are missing, and bodies have been recovered. The exact number of passengers and missing individuals varies across reports, with figures ranging from 130 to over 100 missing.
